reasons.plausibility: Cu has negligible solid solubility in refractory BCC metals, tends to form embrittling intermetallics or liquid phases at high temperature, and would severely degrade 1600 °C strength and irradiation resistance, making the proposed mechanism physically unsound.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-defined, with specific processing, characterization, and mechanical/irradiation testing that would decisively falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes an intervention (Cu addition) that is fundamentally incompatible with refractory alloy metallurgy and would be immediately dismissed by experts.
